claim_scope: Review round v6 (dual independent review of 946d5782f: Opus 5 B 0/1/5, fresh Fable 5.1 B 0/1/6, same P2): the offline receipt gate now recomputes the vector sequence, every recorded Python outcome (code, no-op, effect emptiness, canonical pre/post/effect-plan roots) and every program hash through the real Python transition, so a transition change or a forged row is red without a Tau binary; the transition sources are pinned; the Rust leg compares the canonical roots as well as the codes; three seam discriminators make all eleven adjacent precedence pairs of the twelve-code transition covered (eight recomputed, three contract-tier); transcripts are hashed with wall-clock lines removed; a timeout is a typed FAIL_CLOSED; the unexpanded-definition class is recorded by a selftest probe. Re-cut of PR #534 after independent review (receipt docs/research/reviews/ZENODEX_TAU_ADT_LOGICAL_ABI_PR534_REVIEW_95b3cd6e1568.md). Replayed unmodified at its exact pin 1c1e58ae the PR test failed: min() reached through the return-annotated bounded_fee wrapper was unresolved, the engine printed an error and still answered T, and the harness refused. The asset spec now applies min with typed arguments directly (always-theorem T, strict falsification F at 1c1e58ae and 3c24bad9). The PR's queries are retained as labelled capability probes (definitional projections of their own predicates plus min/recurrence builtin facts) and ZenoDEX transition semantics are bound by a vector tier: experiments/tau_adt_abi/render_tau_adt_abi_v2.py reads the ADT declarations verbatim from the spec, runs the real Python transition over 26 vectors (24 recompute: a universal implication over every result the recomputed guard chain admits plus a non-vacuity program; 2 contract: host-produced EFFECT_DELTA_OVERFLOW and the 4097-row ceiling checked by the spec's own result algebra), derives the reject-code map from AssetTransferRejectCodeV1 declaration order, and writes a receipt hash-bound to the spec, journal spec, lock and renderer bytes. The CI-pinned evidence is the offline receipt gate; live execution is opt-in and fails closed with TAU_PIN_UNAVAILABLE when requested without the binary. BALANCE_OVERFLOW is unreachable from a well-formed state and is recorded as such. Research-only; no authority; the theorems in the specs are not claims about the transition.
failure_modes: a spec, lock or renderer edit is accepted without a fresh replay receipt
a Tau verdict line is trusted although the transcript carries an engine (Error)
min() is reached through a return-annotated definition wrapper and silently resolves to unsat
the guard chain recomputed in Tau admits a result the Python transition never produces (over-permissiveness hidden by an existential encoding)
a reachable reject code has no vector, or the reject-code map drifts from AssetTransferRejectCodeV1 declaration order
the Python transition changes (a swapped guard, a re-routed fee) and the receipt's recorded outcomes or program hashes go stale while the pinned gate stays green
a rejected result changes the abstract state root or carries effects in Python, Rust or Tau
a definitional projection of an ADT predicate is presented as a transition-semantics claim
the evidence is replayed against a mutable source name instead of the exact locked Tau revision
Tau Tables are claimed or used before first-class Tables support is available

aaa.reason: Arrange: the renderer builds each vector by running the real Python transition and pins every ADT member of context, command and state to literals. Act: Tau decides a universal implication over every result the recomputed guard chain admits (plus a non-vacuity program), or, for contract vectors, the spec's own result algebra over the host-produced record; capability probes and falsification probes run first. Assert: exactly one T/F per program, (Error) fails closed, the receipt is hash-bound to the exact spec, lock and renderer bytes and verified offline.

reject_is_noop.reason: In Python the no-op is enforced by the result type: AssetTransferRejectedV1.__post_init__ refuses a changed state root or non-empty effects, so the observed noop/effects_empty are true by construction and this dimension does not discriminate on the Python leg. The vector tier re-checks the property in Tau over the recomputed chain (every reject branch requires post == pre and effects_empty) and, for contract vectors, over the closed algebra; the Rust leg asserts it on every rejection.

boundary_dimensions.name: guard_edges
points: fee at the cap accepts, one atom over rejects
balance exactly amount+fee accepts, one atom short rejects
amount+fee at the bv[16] band limit accepts

boundary_dimensions.name: precedence_discriminators
points: eight adjacent pairs of the nine recomputed guards, one vector each, where both guards want to fire; the oracle decides the code and Tau recomputes it

three seam pairs to the out-of-band classes (FEE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED/EFFECT_DELTA_OVERFLOW, EFFECT_DELTA_OVERFLOW/INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE, INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE/POST_STATE_RESOURCE_BOUND_EXCEEDED) as contract-tier vectors; all eleven adjacent pairs of the twelve-code precedence are covered
a precedence drift in the Python transition is red offline through the recomputation, and a drift between Python and Tau is a parity F

boundary_dimensions.name: domain_ceilings
points: BALANCE_OVERFLOW unreachable from a well-formed state

boundary_dimensions.name: harness_verdict
points: a guard chain weakened to admit every result answers F
a broken program is FAIL_CLOSED, never T/F
the deliberately false whole-ADT statement answers F before any positive evidence

boundary_dimensions.name: min_definition_shape
points: min with typed arguments inline replays T
the return-annotated wrapper form reports an unresolved symbol and a bogus T (rejected by the harness)

forge a receipt with ok=false, a vector verdict F, a missing program, or a capability probe verdict that differs from its expectation

record a rejected vector whose observed Python value is not a no-op or carries effects
render a wrong expected result for an accepting vector (selftest probe, recorded F)
weaken the recomputed guard chain to admit every result (selftest probe, recorded F)
pin a contract-tier record with the wrong reject code or with effects not empty (selftest probes, recorded F)
feed a syntactically broken program (selftest probe, recorded FAIL_CLOSED)
record a Rust-leg outcome that differs from the receipt's Python code for any vector, or drop/reorder a vector in either artifact
swap two adjacent guards in src/core/asset_transfer_module_v1.py (the receipt's recorded outcome and program hash for the discriminator vector no longer recompute)
route the transfer fee to the recipient instead of policy.fee_owner (the recomputed post-state and effect-plan roots differ from the receipt)
replace a recorded program sha256 with a different value
rename the definition in a contract program (unexpanded application; selftest probe recorded FAIL_CLOSED)

nonclaims: This evidence grants no production, settlement, publication, verifier, migration, release, or value-moving authority.
bv[8]/bv[16] roots, identifiers and amounts are bounded abstract tags; this is not a 128-bit production arithmetic model; roots are equality tokens, not hashes.
The theorems in the two Tau specifications are definitional projections of their own predicates or builtin/recurrence facts (capability probes); they are not claims about the ZenoDEX transition.
The vector tier covers nine reject classes by recomputation and two by contract over host-produced records; BALANCE_OVERFLOW is unreachable from a well-formed state and is not covered by a vector.
The guard precedence recomputed in Tau is hand-mirrored from the Python transition and pinned by discriminator vectors, not derived from the Python source.

The Rust leg replays the identical 29 vectors through the real Rust transition and its committed output must agree with the receipt's Python codes and canonical pre/post/effect-plan roots vector-for-vector; the Rust leg does not execute Tau and the Tau verdicts are those of the receipt.

Agreement between the three legs is on the observed surface only: accept/reject, reject code, pre==post root equality and effect emptiness in Tau, plus the canonical post-state and effect-plan roots between Python and Rust. Individual balances, effect rows and conservation are not compared by this tier; the abstract Tau Result carries no amounts, owners or effect rows.

tau_binary_sha256 and transcript_sha256 in the receipt are recorded provenance, verifiable only by the opt-in live test; offline, the receipt is bound to the Tau revision through the lock's commit string, not to the binary bytes.
This evidence does not validate hashing, signatures, canonical serialization, receipt proofs, table storage, table roots, or Tau Net consensus integration; no Tau Tables construct appears.
This evidence does not close O-008 or any whole-value-movement gate and does not make any O-008 formal-cycle packet current.
The committed receipt is evidence for the exact bytes it names; a live replay is opt-in and never substitutes for the receipt gate.
